How we build a stone and marble wall

The secret of a good stone wall is decided before the first slab arrives: the layout. We template the wall and plan every piece - which vein runs where, where seams land, how corners wrap - so the installed surface reads as one carved block.

Materials

  • Color-matched grout and epoxy seams
  • Marble-look tile with matched veining
  • Large-format porcelain slabs up to 24x48 and larger
  • Natural stone veneer

What Cypress clients ask us

How much does a stone or marble feature wall cost in Cypress?

Stone and marble feature walls in Cypress start at $9,800. Final price depends on wall size, material choice and layout complexity. Porcelain marble-look slabs deliver the same visual result as natural marble at a lower material cost and with far less maintenance - both are quoted in your written estimate.

Is it real marble or porcelain?

Your choice. We install both. Most clients pick large-format porcelain: it is lighter, does not need sealing, and modern prints match marble veining closely enough that guests cannot tell at viewing distance.

How are the seams handled?

Slabs are laid out in advance so veins continue across pieces, seams are kept to 1-2mm and filled with color-matched material. On a finished wall you see the stone, not the grid.

Can stone go around a fireplace?

Yes - fireplace surrounds are one of the most common stone projects. We use heat-rated materials and setting compounds within the fireplace manufacturer's clearances.
